parameters.prompt: Design a precise dark-mode infographic titled NIGHT LAB PIPELINE. Exactly six equal rectangular boxes arranged in two rows of three. Top row left to right: OBSERVE, ASK, TEST. Bottom row left to right: RECORD, REVIEW, SHARE. Exactly five arrows: OBSERVE to ASK; ASK to TEST; TEST vertically down then left to RECORD; RECORD to REVIEW; REVIEW to SHARE. Route the TEST-to-RECORD connector outside the boxes. Boxes 1 and 4 teal, boxes 2 and 5 amber, boxes 3 and 6 cream. Each box contains its exact uppercase label and one small matching line icon. A small owl emblem centered above the title. No extra boxes, arrows, labels, numbers or decorative text. Legible white type, dark navy background, disciplined grid, crisp professional typography.
